question: Will Mark Sutcliffe win the 2026 Ottawa mayoral election?
rules:
The 2026 Ottawa mayoral election is currently scheduled to be held on October 26, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who becomes the next mayor of Ottawa as a result of this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting; however, if there is any ambiguity in the results, this market will resolve according to official information from Ottawa.

evidence.excerpt: Mark Sutcliffe had 53% support among decided voters, compared with 31% for Jeff Leiper, 8% for Neil Saravanamuttoo and 7% for Alex Lawson; 23% of all voters remained undecided. Sutcliffe led in Ottawa's west, east and rural areas, while Leiper led downtown. The survey interviewed 762 adult Ottawa residents from October 4–8, 2026, using a hybrid random telephone and online methodology, with a reported margin of error of ±3.6 percentage points, 19 times out of 20.

Ottawa residents were more likely to say the city was going in the right direction (34%) than the wrong direction (15%), while 48% were neutral. Residents gave mixed reviews of City Hall's performance in listening to citizens.

A majority of Ottawa residents cited transit as the top priority for improvement, with better LRT service and more reliable buses among the leading solutions. The findings came from a survey of 762 adult Ottawa residents conducted October 4–8, 2026.

Advance Voting Day for the 2026 Municipal Elections will take place on Friday, October 16, with voting at assigned ward locations from 10 am to 8 pm. Completed Special Ballot Voter Kits must be received by 8 pm that day to be counted. Electors who do not vote on Advance Voting Day will have one additional in-person opportunity on Voting Day, Monday, October 26.

An ElectRight poll conducted September 17–18 found 35% support for Sutcliffe, 19% for Jeff Leiper, 10% for Neil Saravanamuttoo and 4% for Alex Lawson, while 28% were unsure. Commissioned by Ottawa Compass and iPolitics, the poll surveyed roughly 600 people by phone and text messages and reported a margin of error of ±4 percentage points.

With municipal nominations closed, 14 candidates were vying for mayor, including incumbent Mark Sutcliffe, who was seeking a second term. The listed mayoral candidates included Jeff Leiper, Alex Lawson and Neil Saravanamuttoo. The municipal election was scheduled for October 26.
